retry: same idempotency key and exact arguments
merge_dependency: Server contract must be deployed before this application is merged.

item_fields.context_label: string|null; deal or notification subject name
item_fields.open_url: string|null; relative destination or source notification deep link
item_fields.merged_source_ids: UUID[]; canonical source IDs collapsed into this card
item_fields.action_id: UUID|null; next_action or capture_post_call_action ID for complete-one-action
item_fields.action_version: integer|null; canonical action version, sent as complete-one-action base_version
item_fields.deal_id: UUID|null; owning deal for completion readback, null for non-deal work
item_fields.auto_settled: boolean; canonical resolution placed this item in Settled without a disposition write
item_fields.review_reference: Optional or null home-review.v1 reference. Only open actions, pending reply drafts and pending fact reviews. Missing references preserve source links.

projection.truncated: boolean; the item limit or 10000-notification scan bound was exceeded
projection.ordering: Unfinished first, newest activity first, item ID as tie breaker
projection.completion: Only task items have action_id and action_version. Complete the representative action only; merged_source_ids are display provenance, never a bulk completion instruction. No task reopening verb is added.
projection.settlement: Canonical done tasks, sent replies, resolved fact reviews and received tour feedback settle automatically. A future snooze and explicit un-settle take precedence. Notification completion and call-processing completion do not prove all underlying work resolved. Tour feedback resolves only for the exact share grant that received a client shortlist or comment. Versions remain the existing disposition-command authority; retry exact requests and hydrate receipts through this read.

fallback.notice: Automatic settlement unavailable. Showing the earlier inbox; completed items may still need review.
